## #381-D3 — DESIGN BLOCKED

**D3 C-scoped production candidate did not pass the Windows 100k writer-liveness gate. Do not merge.** PR #383 remains OPEN/Draft. Production-code work is stopped pending Owner design direction; this branch does not implement a generation-table or staged-publication redesign.

### Exact source and diff

- Starting master HEAD: `3275ac7c72df8ae4139a30f16c7f649971324e97`
- Starting master Tree: `009576241cd4e8e2ba12cc644a368314f599faa6`
- Candidate PR HEAD: `8dc84751e589c2988fd1c0d3ef8358005afe2f26`
- Candidate Tree: `858b10afa4fc7de90e9a3403d6d99c56f7c2866b`
- PR diff from starting master: 41 files, 10,978 insertions, 551 deletions. D3 diff from the D2 candidate `b79b97a2afc6c40ec57719325f86c486666d0bee`: 34 files, 8,063 insertions, 301 deletions. Per-file diff is available in the [PR Files view](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/pull/383/files).

### Windows 100k gate — failed

Exact candidate CI run [38198131330](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/actions/runs/38198131330), Windows [Performance / Scan & Schema job 114647020467](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/actions/runs/38198131330/job/114647020467), ran the real project Schema fixture with 100,000 missing rows and the production 5,000 ms busy timeout.

- Candidates: 100,000
- Preflight outside the writer transaction: 9,895.413 ms
- BEGIN IMMEDIATE → COMMIT: 5,284.346 ms
- Writer-lock residency: 5,284.319 ms; BEGIN wait: 0.026 ms
- Metadata writer: failed with `database is locked` at its 5,000 ms busy timeout
- Set-based stale UPDATE: 3,166.346 ms
- In-transaction candidate-set recheck: 499.093 ms
- In-transaction leaf filesystem recheck: 1,033.749 ms
- Final CAS and invalidation SQL: 367.222 ms
- COMMIT: 182.424 ms
- Root boundary recheck: 0.195 ms; legacy-proof recheck: 15.514 ms; directory-chain recheck: 0.149 ms; unclassified lock time: 19.624 ms

This improves on the prior Windows 100k result at D2 HEAD `b79b97a` (30.352210 s writer lock and a 5,000 ms writer timeout), but still exceeds the hard limit by 284.319 ms. The performance test stops at the metadata-writer liveness assertion, so it did not reach its exact stale-count, FTS/File Library, tag-writer elapsed-time, or WAL-growth assertions. No WAL number is claimed for this run.

The cost is now concentrated in the required per-row stale UPDATE and commit-time filesystem/CAS work. Removing the remaining checks or exposing partial stale batches would violate the accepted atomicity and fail-closed contract. Further progress needs an Owner-directed design for atomic, bounded visibility (including File Library, FTS, tags/history, dedupe, content/analysis readers, Watcher/root ownership, and crash recovery). D3 does not implement that redesign.

### Test and platform evidence

- Test-first writer-liveness history: regression test commit `f54c57b` preceded the optimization commit `b79b97a`; the previous exact Windows CI run reproduced the timeout. The 100k C-scoped candidate is **not new-passes**: the current exact-head gate still fails as above.
- Commit `8dc8475` fixes two harness issues found during validation: test threads now wait on the transaction-acquired start signal without treating the 5-second SQLite busy timeout as a preflight barrier, and legacy migration assertions expect provisional schema version 38. The SQLite busy timeout and writer elapsed assertions were not changed.
- Windows and macOS release compiles passed on run 38198131330. Both platform Rust jobs failed on the same new migration-test assertion: after marking the row stale, `search_files("oldmarker")` correctly returns zero visible rows, while the test incorrectly expected one. The test must assert the raw FTS term remains indexed and that File Library hides the stale row. It is not changed here because the Windows performance gate requires stopping D3 production work. The remaining macOS native-performance and Workspace Foundation jobs were still running when work stopped.
- The initial run on `6c413eb` also exposed a 5-second test-start barrier expiring during the 100k preparation; that produced no lock measurement and was corrected before this candidate run.

### D2 research and schema compatibility

The reproducible D2 harness, production Schema 37 dump, 20 raw runs, failure-safety contracts, FTS contract, report, and manifest are in [docs/project/research/issue-381-d2](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/tree/8dc84751e589c2988fd1c0d3ef8358005afe2f26/docs/project/research/issue-381-d2). `sha256sum -c MANIFEST.sha256` passed for all 16 listed artifacts. The large syscall trace is not stored in the branch; its summarized measurements and SHA-256 are recorded in `wal-syscalls-summary.json`.

The v37→v38 conditional `files_au` migration is a **Draft-only candidate**, not a frozen shared allocation or approved release migration. #380 remains open with Draft D0 PR #385 and has no verified v38 allocation. Before either track merges, Owners must coordinate one migration sequence: if #380 takes v38 first, move #381 to v39; if #381 takes v38 first, layer #380 after it; if both ship together, combine the independent changes in a single reviewed v38 migration. Existing v37 databases are covered by the candidate migration and rollback/idempotency tests; release compatibility remains pending that cross-track decision.

**Status: #381-D3 DESIGN BLOCKED — READY_FOR_OWNER_DESIGN_REVIEW**. No Codex Review, merge, Issue closure, or release was performed.
